State Switching.description: Switching between discrete configurations, datasets, algorithms, or modes that qualitatively change what is displayed (e.g., selecting a dataset, toggling a view, choosing a preset).
examples: Kernel Selection (Image processing with convolution kernels)
Custom Kernel Editing (Image processing with convolution kernels)
Change Growth Factor (Exponential growth as repeated multiplication)

Parameter Exploration.description: Adjusting a continuous or near-continuous parameter to observe how the visualization responds (e.g., changing radius, frequency, learning rate, threshold via slider or dial).
examples: Wrap Size (The definition of Pi as the ratio of circumference)
Adjust Animation Steps (Exponential growth as repeated multiplication)
Controlling iteration steps (The Mandelbrot set's generation from iterating a f)

Freeform Construction.description: Creating or editing content freely: drawing on a canvas, writing code, editing numerical values, uploading media (e.g., drawing a custom signal, editing matrix cells, writing shader code).
examples: Image Upload (Image processing with convolution kernels)
Live Video Input (Image processing with convolution kernels)
Draw Custom Signal (Fourier decomposition of signals)

Direct Manipulation.description: Dragging or repositioning objects within the visualization to alter the underlying data or model in real time (e.g., moving data points, control points, graph nodes).
examples: Define Construction (Euclidean geometric constructions with compass and)
Repositioning a complex number (The Mandelbrot set's generation from iterating a f)
Drawing the set (The Mandelbrot set's generation from iterating a f)

Temporal Control.description: Controlling the time dimension of a simulation or animation: play, pause, step through, scrub a timeline, adjust speed (e.g., stepping through a sorting algorithm, replaying a simulation).
examples: Control Animation Speed (Exponential growth as repeated multiplication)
Restart Animation (Exponential growth as repeated multiplication)
Algorithmic Step-through (Mathematical definition and geometric construction)

Inspection.description: Exploring details without modifying state: hovering for tooltips, cursor tracking, highlighting related elements (e.g., hovering over a data point to see its label).
examples: Pixel Inspection (Image processing with convolution kernels)
Cursor Position Tracking (Mathematical definition and geometric construction)
Hover over data points (Dimensionality reduction of high-dimensional vecto)

Spatial Navigation.description: Navigating a spatial view: zooming, panning, rotating a 3D scene (e.g., rotating a 3D surface, zooming into a fractal).
examples: Zooming the view (The Mandelbrot set's generation from iterating a f)
Resetting the view (The Mandelbrot set's generation from iterating a f)
Rotating the data cloud (Principal components analysis for dimensionality r)

Scroll-driven Narrative.description: Scrolling the page triggers synchronized animations or progresses through a step-by-step visual narrative.
examples: Scroll-driven Slideshow (Generation of Julia set fractals through the itera)
Scroll-based Animation (Decision tree classification)
